definitions.name: Eladrin
definitions.summary: Fey elf tied to the seasons. Darkvision, trance, and a short-range teleport.

definitions.name: Keen Senses
definitions.summary: Proficiency in Perception.

definitions.name: Fey Ancestry
definitions.summary: Advantage on saves against being charmed; magic can't put you to sleep.

definitions.name: Trance
definitions.summary: Meditate 4 hours instead of sleeping; a long rest takes 4 hours.

definitions.name: Fey Step (Summer)
definitions.summary: Bonus action: teleport up to 30 ft. From 3rd level, Summer adds fire damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) to creatures of your choice within 5 ft after the step.

actions.name: Fey Step
actions.note: Teleport up to 30 ft. Summer: then fire damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) to creatures you choose within 5 ft.

definitions.name: Tiefling
definitions.summary: Infernal heritage: darkvision, fire resistance and a little innate magic.

definitions.name: Infernal Legacy
definitions.summary: Thaumaturgy cantrip; from 3rd level Hellish Rebuke as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest; from 5th level Darkness once per long rest. Charisma is the casting ability.

actions.name: Hellish Rebuke
actions.note: When a creature you can see within 60 ft damages you: 3d10 fire, Dexterity save for half (2nd level).

definitions.name: Variant Human
definitions.summary: +1 to two abilities, one skill, one feat, and an extra language.

definitions.name: Mountain Dwarf
definitions.summary: Strong, hardy dwarf: darkvision, poison resistance, dwarven weapons and light and medium armor. Speed 25 ft, not reduced by heavy armor.

definitions.name: Dwarven Armor Training
definitions.summary: Proficiency with light and medium armor.

definitions.name: Drow
definitions.summary: Dark elf of the Underdark: 120 ft darkvision, innate drow magic and drow weapons, but hampered by direct sunlight.

definitions.name: Superior Darkvision
definitions.summary: Darkvision out to 120 ft.

definitions.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
definitions.summary: Disadvantage on attack rolls, and on sight-based Perception checks, while you, the target or what you look at is in direct sunlight.

when.text: you, the target or what you're trying to see is in direct sunlight
relying on sight, with you or what you're trying to see in direct sunlight

definitions.name: Drow Magic
definitions.summary: Dancing lights cantrip; from 3rd level faerie fire once per long rest; from 5th level darkness once per long rest. Charisma is the casting ability.

actions.name: Faerie Fire (Drow Magic)
actions.note: From 3rd level, once per long rest without a slot.

actions.name: Darkness (Drow Magic)
actions.note: From 5th level, once per long rest without a slot.

definitions.name: Drow Weapon Training
definitions.summary: Proficiency with rapiers, shortswords and hand crossbows.

definitions.name: Wood Elf
definitions.summary: Swift, wary elf of the forests: 35 ft speed, elven weapons, and able to hide in light natural cover.

definitions.name: Fleet of Foot
definitions.summary: Base walking speed 35 ft (already in the race's speed).

definitions.name: Mask of the Wild
definitions.summary: You can try to hide when only lightly obscured by nature: foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist and the like.

definitions.name: Forest Gnome
definitions.summary: Small, shy gnome with a knack for illusion and a way with small animals.

definitions.name: Natural Illusionist
definitions.summary: You know the minor illusion cantrip, cast with Intelligence.

definitions.name: Speak with Small Beasts
definitions.summary: Through sounds and gestures you can share simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts.

definitions.name: Stout Halfling
definitions.summary: Hardy halfling: lucky and brave, with poison resistance and advantage on saves against poison.

definitions.name: Stout Resilience
definitions.summary: Resistance to poison damage and advantage on saves against being poisoned.

definitions.name: Lineage Ability Scores
definitions.summary: The third ability point of a Van Richten's lineage: +1 to any ability. Picking one of the two already raised gives +2/+1; a different one gives +1/+1/+1.

definitions.name: Ancestral Legacy
definitions.summary: Proficiency in two skills of your choice. (A character who replaced an earlier race may instead keep that race's skills and climb, fly or swim speeds; enter those by hand.)

definitions.name: Dhampir
definitions.summary: Half-vampire: 35 ft speed with spider climbing, darkvision, no need to breathe, and a life-draining bite. Ability scores: +1 to two different abilities here, plus one more +1 from Lineage Ability Scores (repeat one for +2/+1, or pick a third for +1/+1/+1). Small or Medium; the app tracks Medium.

definitions.name: Deathless Nature (Dhampir)
definitions.summary: You don't need to breathe.

definitions.name: Spider Climb
definitions.summary: Climbing speed equal to your walking speed. From 3rd level you can move on walls and upside down on ceilings with your hands free.

definitions.name: Vampiric Bite
definitions.summary: A 1d4 piercing bite you're proficient with, using Constitution for attack and damage; advantage while you're missing half or more of your HP. Proficiency-bonus times per long rest, a bite that hits a living creature heals you by the damage or adds the damage to your next check or attack roll.

when.text: you're missing half or more of your hit points

actions.name: Empower (Vampiric Bite)
actions.note: After a bite hits a creature that isn't a construct or undead: regain HP equal to its piercing damage, or add that much to your next ability check or attack roll.

definitions.name: Hexblood
definitions.summary: Fey touched by a hag: darkvision, a magical token to send messages and spy through, and innate hex magic. Ability scores: +1 to two different abilities here, plus one more +1 from Lineage Ability Scores (repeat one for +2/+1, or pick a third for +1/+1/+1). Small or Medium; the app tracks Medium.

definitions.name: Eerie Token
definitions.summary: Bonus action, once per long rest: shed a hair, nail or tooth that stays magical until your next long rest. While it does, use an action to send it a 25-word telepathic message, or to see and hear from it for up to 1 minute (both within 10 miles); viewing destroys it.

actions.name: Eerie Token
actions.note: Create a token that stays magical until your next long rest.

actions.name: Token: telepathic message
actions.note: Within 10 miles: up to 25 words to whoever holds or carries the token.

actions.name: Token: remote viewing
actions.note: Within 10 miles: see and hear from the token for up to 1 minute; you're blind and deaf to your own surroundings. The token is destroyed afterwards.

definitions.name: Hex Magic
definitions.summary: Disguise self and hex, each once per long rest without a slot (or with your slots), cast with Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma (chosen once).

spells.name: Disguise Self
spells.casting: Free once per long rest, or with a slot

spells.name: Hex
spells.casting: Free once per long rest, or with a slot

actions.name: Disguise Self (free)
actions.note: Once per long rest without a slot.

actions.name: Hex (free)
actions.note: Once per long rest without a slot.

definitions.name: Reborn
definitions.summary: Someone who came back from death: hard to kill, needs no food, air or sleep, and has flashes of a past life. Ability scores: +1 to two different abilities here, plus one more +1 from Lineage Ability Scores (repeat one for +2/+1, or pick a third for +1/+1/+1). Small or Medium; the app tracks Medium.

definitions.name: Deathless Nature (Reborn)
definitions.summary: Poison resistance; advantage on saves against disease and being poisoned, and on death saves. No need to eat, drink, breathe or sleep, magic can't put you to sleep, and a long rest is 4 hours of motionless, conscious rest.

definitions.name: Knowledge from a Past Life
definitions.summary: Proficiency-bonus times per long rest, after seeing the d20 of a skill check, add 1d6 to it.

actions.name: Knowledge from a Past Life
actions.note: After seeing the d20 of an ability check that uses a skill: add 1d6.

definitions.name: Celestial Resistance
definitions.summary: Resistance to necrotic and radiant damage.

definitions.name: Healing Hands
definitions.summary: Action, once per long rest: touch a creature to restore hit points equal to your level.

actions.name: Healing Hands
actions.note: Touch a creature: it regains hit points equal to your level.

definitions.name: Light Bearer
definitions.summary: You know the Light cantrip (Charisma).

definitions.name: Necrotic Shroud
definitions.summary: From 3rd level, an action once per long rest: for 1 minute (end it as a bonus action) creatures within 10 ft that can see you make a Charisma save (8 + proficiency + Charisma) or are frightened of you until the end of your next turn, and once on each of your turns one target you damage takes extra necrotic damage equal to your level.

actions.name: Necrotic Shroud
actions.note: From 3rd level. Nearby creatures that see you: Charisma save or frightened until the end of your next turn. Once per turn, extra necrotic damage equal to your level.

when.text: once on each of your turns

definitions.name: Radiant Soul
definitions.summary: From 3rd level, an action once per long rest: for 1 minute (end it as a bonus action) you have a flying speed of 30 ft, and once on each of your turns one target you damage takes extra radiant damage equal to your level.

actions.name: Radiant Soul
actions.note: From 3rd level. Flying speed 30 ft; once per turn, extra radiant damage equal to your level.

when.text: once on each of your turns

definitions.name: Radiant Consumption
definitions.summary: From 3rd level, an action once per long rest: for 1 minute (end it as a bonus action) you shed bright light; at the end of each of your turns you and every creature within 10 ft take radiant damage equal to half your level (rounded up), and once on each of your turns one target you damage takes extra radiant damage equal to your level.

actions.name: Radiant Consumption
actions.note: From 3rd level. Bright light 10 ft; end of each of your turns, you and creatures within 10 ft take radiant damage equal to half your level. Once per turn, extra radiant damage equal to your level.

when.text: once on each of your turns

definitions.name: Fallen Aasimar
definitions.summary: Celestial-touched: darkvision, resistance to necrotic and radiant damage, Healing Hands, the Light cantrip, and from 3rd level a transformation once per long rest. Fallen: Necrotic Shroud.

definitions.name: Protector Aasimar
definitions.summary: Celestial-touched: darkvision, resistance to necrotic and radiant damage, Healing Hands, the Light cantrip, and from 3rd level a transformation once per long rest. Protector: Radiant Soul (flight).

definitions.name: Scourge Aasimar
definitions.summary: Celestial-touched: darkvision, resistance to necrotic and radiant damage, Healing Hands, the Light cantrip, and from 3rd level a transformation once per long rest. Scourge: Radiant Consumption.

definitions.name: Powerful Build
definitions.summary: You count as one size larger for carrying capacity and what you can push, drag or lift.

definitions.name: Long-Limbed
definitions.summary: Your melee attacks on your own turn have 5 ft more reach.

definitions.name: Sneaky
definitions.summary: Proficiency in Stealth.

definitions.name: Surprise Attack
definitions.summary: Once per combat, if you hit a creature you surprised during your first turn, the attack deals 2d6 extra damage.

when.text: the target is surprised, on your first turn; once per combat

definitions.name: Bugbear
definitions.summary: Big, stealthy goblinoid: darkvision, long reach on your turn, Stealth, and a 2d6 Surprise Attack.

definitions.name: Firbolg Magic
definitions.summary: Detect Magic and Disguise Self (you can look up to 3 ft shorter), each once per short or long rest; Wisdom is the casting ability.

definitions.name: Hidden Step
definitions.summary: Bonus action, once per short or long rest: invisible until the start of your next turn, or until you attack, roll damage or force a save.

actions.name: Hidden Step
actions.note: Invisible until the start of your next turn; ends if you attack, roll damage or force a saving throw.

definitions.name: Speech of Beast and Leaf
definitions.summary: Beasts and plants understand the meaning of your words (you don't understand them), and you have advantage on Charisma checks to influence them.

definitions.name: Firbolg
definitions.summary: Gentle forest giant-kin: a little druidic magic, a short invisibility, and a way with beasts and plants.

definitions.name: Fury of the Small
definitions.summary: Once per short or long rest, when you damage a creature larger than you with an attack or spell, add damage equal to your level.

when.text: the target is larger than you; once per short rest

definitions.name: Nimble Escape
definitions.summary: Disengage or Hide as a bonus action on each of your turns.

actions.name: Nimble Escape
actions.note: Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

definitions.name: Goblin
definitions.summary: Small and quick: darkvision, extra damage against bigger foes, and Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

definitions.name: Natural Athlete
definitions.summary: Proficiency in Athletics.

definitions.name: Stone's Endurance
definitions.summary: Reaction when you take damage, once per short or long rest: roll a d12, add your Constitution modifier, and take that much less damage.

actions.name: Stone's Endurance
actions.note: When you take damage: reduce it by 1d12 + your Constitution modifier.

definitions.name: Mountain Born
definitions.summary: Resistance to cold damage; at home at high altitude.

definitions.name: Goliath
definitions.summary: Mountain-born giant-kin: Athletics, cold resistance, and Stone's Endurance to shrug off a hit.

definitions.name: Martial Training
definitions.summary: Proficiency with two martial weapons of your choice and with light armor.

definitions.name: Saving Face
definitions.summary: Once per short or long rest, when you miss an attack or fail a check or save, add a bonus equal to the number of allies you can see within 30 ft (at most +5).

actions.name: Saving Face
actions.note: After a miss or a failed check or save: + the allies you see within 30 ft (max +5).

definitions.name: Hobgoblin
definitions.summary: Disciplined goblinoid: darkvision, two martial weapons and light armor, and Saving Face.

definitions.name: Expert Forgery
definitions.summary: You can copy handwriting and craftwork, with advantage on checks to make forgeries or duplicates.

definitions.name: Kenku Training
definitions.summary: Proficiency in two of Acrobatics, Deception, Stealth and Sleight of Hand.

definitions.name: Mimicry
definitions.summary: You can imitate sounds and voices you've heard; a listener sees through it with Insight against your Deception.

definitions.name: Kenku
definitions.summary: Flightless bird-folk: forgers and mimics who speak only through Mimicry (they read and write Common and Auran).

definitions.name: Grovel, Cower, and Beg
definitions.summary: Action, once per short or long rest: until the end of your next turn, allies have advantage on attacks against enemies within 10 ft of you that you can see.

actions.name: Grovel, Cower, and Beg
actions.note: Allies get advantage on attacks against enemies within 10 ft of you that you can see, until the end of your next turn.

definitions.name: Pack Tactics
definitions.summary: Advantage on an attack against a creature with an ally of yours within 5 ft of it who isn't incapacitated.

when.text: an ally within 5 ft of the target, not incapacitated

definitions.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
definitions.summary: Disadvantage on attacks, and on Perception that relies on sight, when you, the target or what you look at is in direct sunlight.

definitions.name: Kobold
definitions.summary: Small draconic scavengers: darkvision, Pack Tactics, Grovel, Cower, and Beg, but bothered by sunlight.

definitions.name: Swim Speed
definitions.summary: Swimming speed 30 ft.

definitions.name: Bite
definitions.summary: Your bite is a natural weapon for unarmed strikes: 1d6 piercing + Strength.

definitions.name: Cunning Artisan
definitions.summary: During a short rest, turn bone and hide from a slain Small or larger creature into a shield, a club, a javelin or 1d4 darts or blowgun needles (with a blade, like a dagger).

definitions.name: Hold Breath
definitions.summary: You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes.

definitions.name: Hunter's Lore
definitions.summary: Proficiency in two of Animal Handling, Nature, Perception, Stealth and Survival.

definitions.name: Natural Armor
definitions.summary: Without armor your AC is 13 + Dexterity; a shield still adds.

definitions.name: Hungry Jaws
definitions.summary: Bonus action, once per short or long rest: a bite attack; on a hit you gain temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (at least 1).

actions.name: Hungry Jaws
actions.note: Bite as a bonus action; on a hit, temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (min 1).

definitions.name: Lizardfolk
definitions.summary: Cold-eyed reptilian hunters: natural armor 13 + Dex, a bite, swimming, and Hungry Jaws.

definitions.name: Aggressive
definitions.summary: Bonus action: move up to your speed toward a hostile creature you can see or hear, ending closer to it.

actions.name: Aggressive
actions.note: Move up to your speed toward an enemy you can see or hear.

definitions.name: Primal Intuition
definitions.summary: Proficiency in two of Animal Handling, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Nature, Perception and Survival.

definitions.name: Orc
definitions.summary: Fierce and driven: darkvision, a bonus-action charge, two instinct skills and Powerful Build.

definitions.name: Feline Agility
definitions.summary: When you move on your turn in combat, double your speed until the end of the turn; to use it again, move 0 ft on one of your turns first.

actions.name: Feline Agility
actions.note: Double speed this turn. Recharges after a turn where you move 0 ft.

definitions.name: Cat's Claws
definitions.summary: Climbing speed 20 ft; your claws are natural weapons for unarmed strikes: 1d4 slashing + Strength.

definitions.name: Cat's Talent
definitions.summary: Proficiency in Perception and Stealth.

definitions.name: Tabaxi
definitions.summary: Curious cat-folk: darkvision, claws and climbing, Perception and Stealth, and bursts of double speed.

definitions.name: Swim Speed
definitions.summary: Swimming speed 30 ft.

definitions.name: Amphibious
definitions.summary: You breathe air and water.

definitions.name: Control Air and Water
definitions.summary: Fog Cloud; from 3rd level Gust of Wind; from 5th level Wall of Water. Each once per long rest, Charisma as the casting ability.

resources.name: Control Air and Water: Fog Cloud
Control Air and Water: Gust of Wind (3rd level+)

definitions.name: Emissary of the Sea
definitions.summary: Water-breathing beasts understand simple ideas you speak (you don't understand them).

definitions.name: Guardians of the Depths
definitions.summary: Resistance to cold damage, and you ignore the drawbacks of deep water.

definitions.name: Triton
definitions.summary: Guardians of the deep: amphibious, swimming, cold resistance and a little air and water magic.

definitions.name: Innate Spellcasting
definitions.summary: Poison Spray cantrip; Animal Friendship at will on snakes only; from 3rd level Suggestion once per long rest. Charisma is the casting ability.

definitions.name: Magic Resistance
definitions.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

definitions.name: Poison Immunity
definitions.summary: Immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition.

definitions.name: Yuan-ti Pureblood
definitions.summary: Serpent-blooded humans: darkvision, magic resistance, poison immunity and innate snake magic.
